output.summary: A user diagnosed with type 2 diabetes six months ago asked whether trying diet and exercise before starting metformin was wrong. The bot helped build a monitored 3-month trial of slow post-meal walks, smaller rice portions and care with sweets, followed by an HbA1c recheck and a conversation with the doctor. The user accepted this plan and said they would discuss it with their family, ending with a noncommittal thanks. No safety-critical moments occurred.
